input: The samples of one mono channel in order and their sample rate; for the integrated loudness, a run of 100 ms segment energies (already multiplied by their gains).
output: Per 100 ms segment the mean square of the K-weighted signal and the 4x oversampled true peak (EBU R 128 / ITU-R BS.1770-4); the gated integrated loudness (-70 LUFS absolute, -10 LU relative) of any run of segments.
specification: User 2026-10-24: A1 and A2 normalised to the project's EBU R 128 targets. Measured once in the pass of the wave of every frame; any stretch of the program at any gain is measured again from the segments, without reading the sound.
